The Tavola line reads «Giovanni Ventrice | Giuseppe, di Caterina Cichello | 10 novembre».

name: Rosario Comerci (brother of Giacomo Comerci)
bornNote: FIFTY at his death («di anni cinquanta»), so born about 1795, at BRIATICO.
trade: vetturale (carrier; the word is read «vaticale», doubtful)
source: Briatico, Morti 1845, atto 2 (an_ua87703, image 4, LEFT page; read at the image by the session); Briatico, Morti 1817 (an_ua87675, image 16); Briatico, Morti 1825, atti 6 and 7 (an_ua87683, image 5); Briatico, Nati 1829, atto 24 (an_ua87731, image 25)
note: GIACOMO COMERCI'S BROTHER, on the one fact the act gives: he is called son of «Francesco Comerci, bracciale, defunto» and «Catarina Mannella, defonta», the same two parents as in Giacomo's marriage act of 1838 and death act of 1848. Died at one o'clock in the night, in his own house, at fifty, born and living at Briatico. The day is written «due» or «tre» (February 1845): doubtful, and the reader had 3 February. Declarants Giuseppe Artesi (30) and Giovanni Maggi? (40), both braccianti of Briatico, who could not sign. His wife is not named in the act. A Giacomo Comerci, a vetturale who died at Briatico in 1840, is called son of a Rosario Comerci and Nicolina Bongiovanni: very probably this man's son, but nothing in either act says so, and it is not claimed. HE IS ALSO THE DECLARANT OF HIS OWN BROTHER ARCANGELO'S DEATH on 15 September 1817 (Morti 1817, an_ua87675, image 16), giving his age as twenty-eight, which is about 1789, against the fifty of his death act of 1845 (about 1795): a six-year disagreement between two clerks' figures. Not in the family tree. HIS WIFE WAS ANTONIA VOTANO, and he was a «servo» in 1825: Briatico Morti 1825, atto 6 (an_ua87683, image 5, left page, read at the image) is his own mother's death, who died in his house on 16 February 1825, and atto 7 on the same opening is the death of their infant son Nicola, on 27 February, «figlio di Rosario Comerci, servo, e di Antonia Votano». His trades differ from act to act (a tavern-keeper? in 1817, a servo in 1825, a carrier in 1845). IN OCTOBER 1829 HE HAD A DAUGHTER, CATERINA, born at Briatico at sixteen o'clock on 14 October, to Rosario Comerci, a «vaticale», and Antonia Votano, aged twenty (Briatico Nati 1829, atto 24, an_ua87731, image 25, read at the image). His own age there is read «trentaquattro» (thirty-four, the first letters are heavy), which agrees with the thirty-six of March 1832 (Morti 1832, atto 9, where he declared a death) and the fifty of 1845 and against the twenty-eight of 1817, which is the outlier.

name: Francesco Ventrice (b. 1830, son of Giuseppe Ventrice)
bornNote: BORN AT BRIATICO at nine o'clock in the morning of 29 September 1830, declared by his father at noon the same day (Briatico Nati 1830, atto 17, an_ua87732, image 19, read at the image by the session): «Giuseppe Ventrice», «trentadue» (32), bracciale, of Briatico, presents a boy born of «Caterina Cichello», aged «trenta»? (the number is not clear), and gives him the name Francesco; baptised at S. Nicola the same day. Witnesses two builders (fabricatori), Francesco and Michele Sallo? (19 and 27).
source: Briatico, Nati 1830, atto 17 (an_ua87732, image 19, read at the image by the session); Briatico, Morti 1834, atto 14 (an_ua87692, image 9, left page, read at the image by the session)
note: THE LAST CHILD OF THE MARRIAGE, born nine months before his father died (21 June 1831), and the SECOND Francesco: the first, born at Zambrone in 1825 or 1826, lived twelve days. HE DIED AT FOUR. Briatico Morti 1834 atto 14, read at the image: at seven in the evening of 15 September 1834 «Francesco Ventrice di anni quattro», a boy («ragazzo»), born and living at Briatico, died in his own bed, «figlio di Giuseppe Ventrice, bracciale, domiciliato idem defonto, e di Catarina Cichello, domiciliata in Briatico»: his mother alive, his father dead; declared on the 16th at noon by Antonino Ventrice (about 28, miller) and Antonio Vallone (22, miller), neither able to write. Antonino Ventrice is very probably the miller of that name who died at Briatico on 20 September 1836, about forty, son of the late Francesco Ventrice and a Francesca, husband of Giuseppa Giacco (Morti 1836, atto 24, read by a delegated reader, not checked at the image). Nothing read shows him related to Giuseppe Ventrice, whose father was Domenico, son of Paolo: the surname is all that is shared. His mother married Giacomo Comerci four years later, in 1838.

name: Arcangelo Comerci (brother of Giacomo Comerci)
bornNote: TWENTY-SIX at his death («ventisei»; the numeral is heavy ink and may be twenty-eight), so born about 1791, and BORN AT BRIATICO if he lived there all his life, which the act does not say.
source: Briatico, Morti 1817, atto 26 or 28 (an_ua87675, image 16, LEFT page; the number is overwritten; read at the image by the session)
note: A BROTHER OF GIACOMO COMERCI, found in the oldest Briatico death book read so far. Died at seven in the morning of 15 September 1817 in his own house «sotto la Piazza», «figlio del fu Francesco Comerci e di Catarina Mannella» (no «fu» before the mother). The declarants were Rosario Comerci, 28, a tavern-keeper(?), and Pasquale d'Elia, a cotton-worker, neither able to write. The act does not call Rosario his brother, but he has the same surname and his own death act of 1845 names the same two parents. This is the third child of Francesco Comerci and Caterina Mannella the archive holds, after Giacomo and Rosario. Not in the family tree.

name: Antonino Mannella
died: before 16 February 1825 («defonto» in his daughter's death act)
source: Briatico, Morti 1825, atto 6 (an_ua87683, image 5, left page; read at the image by the session)
note: Father of Caterina Mannella, named in her death act of 16 February 1825 as dead. Nothing else is known of him, and the act does not say where he lived.

name: Anna Polito
died: before 16 February 1825 («defonta» in her daughter's death act)
source: Briatico, Morti 1825, atto 6 (an_ua87683, image 5, left page; read at the image by the session)
note: Mother of Caterina Mannella, named in her death act of 16 February 1825 as dead. Nothing else is known of her.

name: Antonia Votano
bornNote: TWENTY at her daughter's birth on 14 October 1829 («venti»), so born about 1809.
source: Briatico, Morti 1825, atto 7 (an_ua87683, image 5, right page; read at the image by the session); Briatico, Nati 1829, atto 24 (an_ua87731, image 25, read at the image)
note: Wife of Rosario Comerci and mother of the infant Nicola, who died on 27 February 1825. Named in that act and in her daughter's birth act of 1829; her own parents, age and death are not known.

name: Nicola Comerci (infant son of Rosario Comerci)
source: Briatico, Morti 1825, atto 7 (an_ua87683, image 5, right page; read at the image by the session)
note: Died eleven days after his grandmother Caterina Mannella, who had died in his father's house. Called «figlio di Rosario Comerci, servo, e di Antonia Votano». His age is not stated in the notes taken from the act, which say only that he was an infant, so no birth date is claimed.

name: Saveria Lucifaro (first wife of Giacomo Comerci)
bornNote: THIRTY at her death («trenta»), so born about 1787.
source: Briatico, Morti 1817, atto 39 (an_ua87675, image 21, read at the image by the session)
note: Died in her own house in the «strada dietro la Chiesa», «figlia di Antonio Lucifaro ed [di] Domenica», «moglie di ___ Comerci»: the husband's forename is left blank, and the declarant Giacomo Comerci, 36, a miller, is called «marito della difonta». The first name is read «Saverda» (Saveria) and is doubtful. Her mother's surname is not given.

name: Antonio Lucifaro
bornNote: FIFTY-SIX in December 1817 and FIFTY at his death in March 1818, so born about 1762-68; the two ages disagree.
source: Briatico, Morti 1817, atto 39 (an_ua87675, image 21, read at the image by the session); Briatico, Morti 1818, atto 10 (an_ua87676, image 7, read by a delegated reader, not checked at the image)
note: Father of Saveria Lucifaro and father-in-law of Giacomo Comerci, who declared his death as «genero». Husband of Domenica (surname read Margiafani?), and son of the late Francesco Lucifaro and Caterina Giorchi, on the delegated reading of his 1818 act.

name: Caterina Polito (wife of Giacomo Comerci)
source: Briatico, Morti 1819, atti 10 and 11 (an_ua87677, image 7; read by a delegated reader, not checked at the image)
note: Named as the mother of the twin sons born to Giacomo Comerci in November 1819, who died at five days old. Whether she is a second wife after Saveria Lucifaro (d. December 1817) or a different man of the same name's wife is not proved. Her own death is not known.

name: Antonino Comerci (twin son of Giacomo Comerci)
died: 18 November 1819, at Briatico, aged five days
father: Giacomo Comerci (second husband of Caterina Cichello)
source: Briatico, Morti 1819, atto 10 (an_ua87677, image 7; read by a delegated reader, not checked at the image)
note: A twin («gemello», added in the margin). The Tavola calls him «bracciale», which is the clerk's error. Not to be confused with the Antonino Comerci of thirty who declared a death in 1849.

name: Giuseppe Comerci (twin son of Giacomo Comerci)
died: 18 November 1819, at Briatico, aged five days
father: Giacomo Comerci (second husband of Caterina Cichello)
source: Briatico, Morti 1819, atto 11 (an_ua87677, image 7; read by a delegated reader, not checked at the image)
note: The other twin, dead on the same day as Antonino, with the same declarants.

name: Francesco Ventrice (brother of Giuseppe Ventrice)
source: Briatico, Morti 1825, atto 24 (an_ua87683, image 16, left page; read at the image by the session)
note: BORN AT ZAMBRONE, living at Briatico, and called «figlio del fu Domenico [Ventrice]» and of «Anna Hampti?» of Zambrone, whose surname is read with doubt (Fama is not excluded by the hand, and Domenico's wife was Anna Fama). That makes him VERY PROBABLY A BROTHER OF GIUSEPPE VENTRICE, and a younger brother if Domenico died in 1815. Declarants Matteo Francesco Triparni (32, tailor) and Gennaro Bongiovanni (34, servo). No age is given; the act number is overwritten. Not to be confused with the Francesco Ventrice «fu Paolo» who died at Zambrone on 17 February 1833.

name: Francesco Comerci (miller, son of Giacomo Comerci)
father: Giacomo Comerci (second husband of Caterina Cichello)
mother: Saveria Lucifaro (first wife of Giacomo Comerci)
source: Briatico, Morti 1827, atto 21 (an_ua87685, image 13, right page; read at the image by the session)
note: Died at twenty o'clock in his own house, «nato in Briatico», a miller like his father, «figlio di Giacomo Comerci, mugnajo, e di Saveria Lucifero», both domiciled at Briatico. NO AGE IS GIVEN. The declarants were Domenico Morello? (24, bracciale) and a second Domenico, 26?, a shoemaker, whose surname is not read. The son's own name is written by a second hand across the act. He is the first child of Giacomo Comerci and Saveria Lucifaro found; her death is December 1817, so he was born before that if she is his mother, as the parents' names say.

name: Caterina Comerci (daughter of Rosario Comerci)
source: Briatico, Nati 1829, atto 24 (an_ua87731, image 25; read at the image by the session)
note: Born at Briatico at sixteen o'clock on 14 October 1829 and named Caterina, her paternal grandmother's first name (Caterina Mannella). The act is annotated that the parish of S. Nicola returned the baptism note on the same day, 14 October. Her death and any marriage are not known.

name: Orazio Arena (b. 1821)
bornNote: Act 156 of Scilla Nati 1821: born at one in the morning on the 14th, declared on the 16th. The act is dated 16 December; the index of the register prints it under December («Xbre»).
source: Scilla, Nati 1821 atto 156, read in the original (image 88)
note: THE BIRTH ACT OF THE ORAZIO ARENA WHO IS IN THE TREE AS A SON OF A GIUSEPPE ARENA, and the first act to give him a mother. «Giuseppe Arena, di anni ventiquattro, marinaro» declares a boy born on the 14th «da Teresa Polistina, di anni ventidue, sua moglie legittima, domiciliata con esso», in their own house, and gives him the name ORAZIO. The witnesses are Pasquale Alfonzetto, 28, negoziante, and an ORAZIO ARENA, marinaro, whose age could not be read: very probably the child's grandfather, Orazio Arena (b. c. 1751), whom the baby is named for. WHAT AGREES: the parents' marriage was on 13 November 1821 (Matrimoni 1821 atto 29), so the child came a month after it; Teresa is 22 here and 21 at her marriage. WHAT DOES NOT QUITE: Giuseppe is 24 here and 27 at his promessa of 7 November 1821; the clerks' ages are approximations. NOT CLAIMED: that this Orazio is the husband of Giovanna Zirilli. The tree makes that identification and this act matches it on name, year, town and the father's forename; no act of Orazio's own marriage or death has been read to join the two.

name: Raffaele Arena (b. 1824)
bornNote: Act 156 of Scilla Nati 1824, registered on 1 August: born at ten o'clock on 31 July. The index of the supplement writes the child as Raffaela; the act says «Maschio».
source: Scilla, Nati 1824 atto 156, read in the original (image 82); the supplement's index (image 13)
note: A SECOND CHILD OF GIUSEPPE ARENA AND TERESA POLISTINA, and a boy, though the annual index lists him as a girl. Giuseppe is 28 and a marinaro; he could not write. Teresa is 22 here (22 also in 1821: the clerks' ages are approximations). No death act of this boy has been sought. A second Raffaele is born to the same parents on 29 March 1827, which may mean the first had died.

name: Raffaele Camillo Arena (b. 1827)
bornNote: Act 63 of Scilla Nati 1827, registered on 30 March: born at four in the afternoon of the 29th. The annual index lists «Raffaela, 29 Marzo»; the act says a male.
source: Scilla, Nati 1827 atto 63, read in the original (image 34)
note: A THIRD CHILD OF GIUSEPPE ARENA AND TERESA POLISTINA, named for the first Raffaele (b. 1824), who is therefore probably dead by March 1827; and Raffaele Polistina was Teresa's own father. Giuseppe is 32 and could not write; Teresa is 28. A further index line of 1827, «Raffaela, Giuseppe e Pontillo Teresa, 18 Giugno», names a PONTILLO mother and could not be found: acts 108 and 109 are missing from the images (see the searched row). SEPARATELY OPEN: a Teresa Polistina is the wife of Domenico Arena in 1838 (row for Teresa Polistina). If Giuseppe died between 1827 and 1838 she may be the same woman, remarried; this is not shown.

name: Giovanni Arena (b. 1821, of Filippo and Domenica Costa)
bornNote: Act 125 of Scilla Nati 1821: born and declared on 18 October. Filippo is given as 26 here although his own baptism gives 1793.
source: Scilla, Nati 1821 atto 125, read in the original (image 72)
note: A SON OF FILIPPO ARENA AND DOMENICA COSTA NOT IN THE TREE, born two years after Francesco Antonio (act 186 of 1819). «Filippo Arena, di anni ventisei, marinaro» declares him; the mother is written «Domenica di Costa», her age either 27 or 17 at 1700 pixels (27 fits her baptism of 1787 less well than 34 would; the ages are approximations). The witnesses are a notary, Giuseppe Melidoni?, 51, and a merchant, Antonino Zagari, 50. His death is not known. A NAMESAKE, NOT THE GIOVANNI ARENA OF THE TREE (two different people): that man was born in 1870, a son of Francesco Antonio Arena and Serafina Arlotta, so he is this boy's nephew and is probably named for him.

name: Letteria Arena (b. 1823, of Filippo and Domenica Costa)
bornNote: Act 157 of Scilla Nati 1823. The index prints 15 October and the act's own words read «sedici»; the parish's note in the margin returns the baptism on 18 October. The day of birth is 15 or 16 October.
source: Scilla, Nati 1823 atto 157, read in the original (image 80); index image 106
note: A DAUGHTER OF FILIPPO ARENA AND DOMENICA COSTA NOT IN THE TREE. The annual index of this archive's earlier reading called her «Vittoria»; the image reads LETTERIA, the name of Filippo's mother-in-law line (his own mother-in-law is not known; Orazio Arena's wife was Litteria Morabito). Filippo is 30 here and a marinaro; the mother's age reads 34?. The witnesses are Giuseppe Marra?, a tailor, and Camillo Furfari, 33, a sailor. Her death is not known.

name: Nunziata Arena (b. 1825, of Filippo and Domenica Costa)
bornNote: Act 49 of Scilla Nati 1825, registered on 7 March: born at eleven at night on the 6th.
source: Scilla, Nati 1825 atto 49, read in the original (image 28)
note: A DAUGHTER OF FILIPPO ARENA AND DOMENICA COSTA NOT IN THE TREE. Filippo is 31, a marinaro, and declares her; the mother is 32. The witnesses are Nunzio Gioffre, 52, a merchant, and Paolo Vita, 22, a sailor. Her death is not known.

name: Domenico Arena (b. 1827, of Filippo and Domenica Costa)
bornNote: Act 42 of Scilla Nati 1827: born at six in the morning on 5 March and declared the same day. The index lists «Domenica»; the act says a male, «Domenico Luigi» and a third name that could not be read.
source: Scilla, Nati 1827 atto 42, read in the original (image 24)
note: A SON OF FILIPPO ARENA AND DOMENICA COSTA NOT IN THE TREE, the fifth child found for them. Filippo is 33, a marinaro; the mother's age reads 34?. The witnesses are Camillo Furfari, 34, and Domenico Merito?, 22, a soapmaker. He is named for no one in Filippo's line that is known; DO NOT CONFUSE HIM with the Domenico Arena who married Teresa Polistina in 1838 (a son of Orazio Arena b. c. 1751) or with the Domenico Arena of 1853.

name: Fortunata Maria Pontillo
bornNote: From «di anni diciannove» in her marriage act of 3 June 1876 (Scilla, Matrimoni 1876 atto 18).
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1876 atto 18, read in the original (image 11); Matrimoni 1906 atto 42
note: WIFE OF GIUSEPPE ARENA, MOTHER OF THE ORAZIO ARENA WHO MARRIED A MUSOLINO IN 1906. Married Giuseppe Arena, 28, a mariner and son of Orazio and Giovanna Zirilli, at Scilla on 3 June 1876; her own parents are named there as Domenico Pontillo and Mariannia Costa, both living. She is still living, and still «Pontillo Fortunata Maria», in her son's marriage act thirty years later. Her parents are not given their own rows here because nothing more is known of them.

name: Orazio Arena (b. c. 1878, m. 1906)
bornNote: From «di anni ventotto» in his marriage act of 20 October 1906 (Scilla, Matrimoni 1906 atto 42).
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1906 atto 42, read in the original (image 22)
note: THE ORAZIO ARENA WHO MARRIED MARIANTONIA MUSOLINO IS THE GRANDSON, NOT THE ELDER ORAZIO. This archive read Domenico Arena's death act of 1923 (father Orazio, mother Mariantonia Musolino) and concluded that the Orazio who married Giovanna Zirilli must have married twice. The marriage act, found 17 November 2026 and read at the image, says otherwise: on 20 October 1906 at Scilla ORAZIO ARENA, twenty-eight, a speculante, born and resident at Scilla, SON OF GIUSEPPE AND OF FORTUNATA MARIA PONTILLO (both living), married ANTONIA MUSOLINO, twenty-seven, daughter of the late Antonino and of Maria Cotroneo; the bride signs «Musolino Mariantonia». His father Giuseppe is the Giuseppe Arena who married Fortunata Maria Pontillo in 1876 and who was the son of Orazio and Giovanna Zirilli; he is NOT the tree's Guiseppe Arena, who was born in 1860 to Francesco Antonio Arena and Serafina Arlotta (see the corrections page). AND DOMENICO ARENA'S DEATH ACT SETTLES IT: act 125 of the Scilla deaths of 1923, read at the image, is for a child of THREE MONTHS, Domenico, born at Scilla, son of ORAZIO, a marinaio, and of MUSOLINO MARIANTONIA, a casalinga, dead on 30 December 1923. A baby born in the autumn of 1923 cannot be the son of the elder Orazio, who was dead by 1895 (Mariantonia was born about 1879), and the parents named are exactly this couple. There was no second marriage of the elder Orazio. TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE from the Orazio Arena of the tree, who was already dead; no connection beyond the grandfather is claimed.

name: Antonia Musolino (Mariantonia)
bornNote: From «di anni ventisette» in her marriage act of 20 October 1906.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1906 atto 42, read in the original (image 22)
note: THE WIFE THE WORK LIST HAS BEEN LOOKING FOR since September: «Mariantonia Musolino», named only in her son Domenico Arena's death act of 1923. The act of 1906 writes her ANTONIA in the body and the index, and she signs MUSOLINO MARIANTONIA, so the two names are one woman. Born and resident at Scilla, a casalinga; her father Antonino was already dead (the act writes «fu Antonino, residente in vita ivi», the formula for a dead parent), her mother Maria Cotroneo living. Her own death is not yet found; the name index holds no Musolino woman of this name at Scilla 1911-1943, so she may have died later, or elsewhere.

name: Antonino Musolino
bornNote: Not stated.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1906 atto 42, read in the original (image 22)
note: ANTONIA MUSOLINO'S FATHER, «fu Antonino» in his daughter's marriage act of 1906: dead by then, and nothing else known. A Musolino, a surname this archive had not held before 17 November 2026.

name: Maria Cotroneo
bornNote: Not stated.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1906 atto 42, read in the original (image 22)
note: ANTONIA MUSOLINO'S MOTHER, living and resident at Scilla on 20 October 1906. Her own parents and her marriage to Antonino Musolino are not yet sought.

name: Francesco Arena (m. 1907, of Orazio and Giovanna Zirilli)
bornNote: Not stated in the index; the act gives an age that is not read here.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1907 atto 41, read in the original (image 23)
note: A SIXTH CHILD OF ORAZIO ARENA AND GIOVANNA ZIRILLI, and the act that DATES THEIR DEATHS from the other side: married Santa Bova, daughter of the late Roccantonio, at Scilla on 14 November 1907 (the day is written over «tredici»), and the act calls his parents «fu Orazio» and «fu Zirilli Giovanna»: both dead by then. That agrees with Orazio's death between 1876 and 1895 and puts Giovanna's before November 1907. The word «residente in vita» sits in the act beside each name: it is the formula for a dead parent, not a sign that they were alive. TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE from the Francesco Arena, son of Carlo and resident at Villa San Giovanni, who married at Scilla in 1877 (read from the index only).

name: Domenico Arena (d. 1923, aged three months)
bornNote: From «mesi tre» in his death act of 30 December 1923 (Scilla, Morti 1923 atto 125).
source: Scilla, Morti 1923 atto 125, read in the original (an_ua16598704, image 66); the Antenati name index
note: THE DOMENICO ARENA WHO MADE THIS ARCHIVE THINK ORAZIO ARENA HAD MARRIED TWICE. The Antenati name index lists a Domenico Arena who died at Scilla on 30 December 1923, father Orazio, mother Mariantonia Musolino, and an earlier session took the father for the Orazio who married Giovanna Zirilli. The act itself, read at the image on 17 November 2026, is for an INFANT: «mesi tre», born at Scilla, died at eleven forty in the morning in via Menacina, the declarants Giuseppe Bellantoni, 71, a sailor, and Salvatore Benedetto, 50, a shoemaker; the father is Orazio, a marinaio, and the mother Musolino Mariantonia, a casalinga. He is the son of the Orazio Arena who married Antonia Musolino on 20 October 1906, and a great-grandson of the elder Orazio. TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE from the Domenico Arena born in 1856 and the Domenico Arena born in 1859, sons of the elder Orazio.

name: Giuseppe Arena (b. c. 1848, m. 1876)
bornNote: From «di anni ventotto» in his marriage act of 3 June 1876 (Scilla, Matrimoni 1876 atto 18).
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1876 atto 18, read in the original (image 11); the Antenati name index, Scilla deaths (1922)
note: A SON OF ORAZIO ARENA AND GIOVANNA ZIRILLI WHO IS IN NO TREE: twenty-eight, a marinaio, born and resident at Scilla, he married FORTUNATA MARIA PONTILLO on 3 June 1876, and the act names his parents as «Orazio» (the surname left blank, a dash) and «Giovanna Zirilli», both living and resident at Scilla. The Scilla death index gives a Giuseppe Arena, husband of Fortunata Maria Pontillo, dead in 1922, which is the same man by his wife. Father of the Orazio Arena who married Antonia Musolino in 1906, whose act names Giuseppe and Fortunata Maria Pontillo as his parents. A Raffaele Arena, a marinaio of twenty-seven, who married at Scilla on 4 April 1912 and whose parents are written Giuseppe and Fortunata Pontillo (read by a delegated reader, Matrimoni 1912 atto 17, not yet at the image), is probably a second son. TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE from the tree's Guiseppe Arena, born 1860 to Francesco Antonio Arena and Serafina Arlotta, and from the Giuseppe Arena born 1839 to Domenico and Teresa Polistina who married Serafina Vita in 1868: three Giuseppe Arena at Scilla alive in the same year.

name: Giovanni Maria Donato
bornNote: Born on 6 April 1858 (Scilla, Nati 1858 atto 50, read at the image); the act was drawn up on the 7th.
source: Scilla, Nati 1858 atto 50, read in the original (an_ua2002925, image 28)
note: A SON OF DOMENICO DONATO AND NUNZIATA SOFI, found in the 1858 birth index and read at the image: Giovanni Maria, born at Scilla on 6 April 1858, declared by the midwife Teresa Arena, daughter of the late Domenico, sixty; the parents' ages are written as 42 and 41, within the error these acts allow. Named for neither grandfather, so the naming custom does not explain him; Giovanni Maria is not found again (no death or marriage read), so he may have died young. A brother of Michele Donato (b. 3 October 1855) and of Pasquale (b. 1860).

name: Rocco Donato (b. 1852)
bornNote: From the 1852 annual index only: «Donato Rocco, di Dom.co e Sofi Annunziata, 22 [settembre?]», act 234; the act itself was not opened.
source: Scilla, Nati 1852, annual index (an_ua2002907, the 1852 supplement's Tavola)
note: A SON OF DOMENICO DONATO AND NUNZIATA SOFI, from the index alone: Rocco, born at Scilla about 22 September 1852, act 234, the month read with a query by the reader and the act not opened. The index names both parents with their usual forms (Dom.co and Sofi Annunziata), which is why he is listed; he is held as an index reading until the act is opened. A brother of Candeloro (b. 1847), Michele (b. 1855) and Pasquale (b. 1860). TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE from the tree's Rocco Donato, son of Michele Donato and Cosima Perina, and from the Rocco Donato born in 1861 to Santo and Santa Barbera (read from an index).

name: Maria Donato (b. 1823)
bornNote: Born at ten in the morning on 9 March 1823 (Scilla, Nati 1823 atto 58, read at the image); declared on the 10th.
source: Scilla, Nati 1823 atto 58, read in the original (an_ua2002818, image 31, the page photographed upside down)
note: A DAUGHTER OF CANDELORO DONATO AND HIS PALADINO WIFE, and a sister of Domenico (b. 1816) and of the Michele born at Messina: declared by Candeloro, 38, a marinaio, who gives the baby the name MARIA, which is the name the 1844 Tavola gives Domenico's mother, so the paternal grandmother's name was probably used for her. THE MOTHER'S FIRST NAME IS STILL THREE WAYS: «Mar-ta» in Domenico's own birth act of 1816, «Maria» in the 1844 marriage Tavola, and «Santa» as the annual indexes of 1818, 1823 and 1824 and the 1823 act itself seem to read it (a cursive M and a cursive S are close in these hands); the act of 1823 (atto 58), read at the image, is written «Santa Paladino» with the first letter doubtful, and her age is thirty-eight. Not found again (no death or marriage read). TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE from the Maria Donato who died in 1891, daughter of Michele Donato and Maria Sofi.

name: Vittoria Donato (b. c. 1818)
bornNote: Born at six o’clock on 9 May 1818 and registered the same day (Scilla, Nati 1818, atto 62, an_ua2002805, image 30, left page, read at the image by a delegated reader from Archivio di Stato di Reggio Calabria images); the annual index (no. 188) gives the birth as «9 d.to», 9 May. The earlier «about 3 May» came from a misreading of that index and is withdrawn.
source: Scilla, Nati 1818, atto 62 (an_ua2002805, image 30); annual index of 1818 (image 110, no. 188)
note: A SISTER OF DOMENICO DONATO, NOW READ IN HER OWN ACT: declarant Candeloro Donato, thirty-two, marinaro, who signs with a cross; mother Santa Paladino, thirty-three, his lawful wife; child named Vittoria; witnesses Pietro Bellantoni, industriante, and Francesco Corsaro, falegname. The act writes the mother as SANTA, so this is a fourth place where the Paladino wife of Candeloro is Santa: her son Domenico’s act of 1816, the indexes of 1818, 1823 and 1824, the act of 1823, and this one. The act was found by its birth date, since the 1818 index numbers run 1-189 on their own and are not act numbers. Vittoria’s fate is not known; she is not the Vittoria Donato of the 1830 index (Tavola 66), whose parents were not read.

name: Teresa Donato (b. 1824)
bornNote: From the 1824 annual index only (the supplement an_ua2002823): «Donato Teresa, Candeloro e Paladino Santa, 22 8bre»; the act was not opened.
source: Scilla, Nati 1824, annual index (an_ua2002823, image 16)
note: A SISTER OF DOMENICO DONATO FROM THE INDEX ALONE: Teresa, born at Scilla about 22 October 1824 to Candeloro Donato and a Paladino wife (written Santa), the last child of the couple so far found. THE MOTHER'S FIRST NAME IS STILL THREE WAYS: «Mar-ta» in Domenico's own birth act of 1816, «Maria» in the 1844 marriage Tavola, and «Santa» as the annual indexes of 1818, 1823 and 1824 and the 1823 act itself seem to read it (a cursive M and a cursive S are close in these hands); the act of 1823 (atto 58), read at the image, is written «Santa Paladino» with the first letter doubtful, and her age is thirty-eight. TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE from the tree's Teresa Donato (no dates), who has no parents in the tree. Held as an index reading until the act is opened.

name: Maria Sofi
bornNote: Twenty-one at her marriage on 17 December 1887 (Scilla, Matrimoni 1887, atto 56, read at the image), so born about 1866; a filatrice (spinner), born and living at Scilla. She could not sign: the act says the bride was illiterate.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1887, atto 56 (an_ua16595008, image 29, read in the original)
note: MICHELE DONATO'S WIFE, AND HER PARENTS AT LAST. The tree and the 1892 birth act gave her no parents; her marriage act names them, DOMENICO SOFI and SANTA ROMANO, named at Scilla in 1887 (the act writes each with a residence at Scilla and without «fu»; but see the UPDATE below: Santa Romano had died in 1869). The groom, Michele Donato, 32, marinaio, son of Domenico and Annunziata SOFI. HER PARENTS' OWN MARRIAGE, found the same day: Domenico Sofi (son of Pasquale Sofi and Maria D'Amico) married Santa Romano at Scilla on 10 September 1855, so Maria's father is the BROTHER of Michele's mother Nunziata Sofi and Maria and Michele were FIRST COUSINS. Witnesses Felice Sisinni (30, civile) and Filippo Pambianco (52, pittore). The index number reads 5 but the act is number 56, the last of Parte I. Row 72 of the work list: her parents are now found, by the marriage act and not by the index. UPDATE 18 NOVEMBER 2026: the Scilla death register has SANTA ROMANO, wife of Domenico Sofi and daughter of the late Domenico Romano and Concetta Pontillo, dying on 15 April 1869 (Morti 1869 atto 47, read at the image), and Domenico Sofi's own death act of 1897 calls him her widower. Maria, born about 1866, was therefore about three when her mother died, and the 1887 act's «residente in Scilla» for Santa is the clerk's form, not evidence that she lived to 1887. The act of 1887 was re-read at the image and does read «di Santa Romano, residente in Scilla» with no «fu».

name: Domenico Sofi
bornNote: Born at 8 p.m. on 5 August 1827 at Scilla, declared on 6 August (Nati 1827, atto 128, read at the image); his father Pasquale Sofi, marinaro, then 37, and Maria d'Amico, 40, 'moglie legittima'. The 1855 promise's 'twenty-eight' agrees to within a year.
died: 16 April 1897, at via Grotte no. 60, Scilla (Morti 1897 atto 55)
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1855, atto 29 (an_ua2002628, image 34, read in the original); Scilla, Nati 1827, atto 128 (an_ua2002831, image 68, read at the image)
note: MARIA SOFI'S FATHER, AND MICHELE DONATO'S MOTHER'S BROTHER. His own marriage act of 1855 names his parents PASQUALE SOFI (a marinaro, alive in 1855) and MARIA D'AMICO, the very pair the 1844 marriage papers name as the parents of Nunziata Sofi, Michele Donato's mother. So Domenico is Nunziata's brother, and MICHELE DONATO MARRIED HIS FIRST COUSIN, Domenico's daughter Maria. He married Santa Romano on 10 September 1855 (the promise was made on 6 July). NOT the Domenico Sofi who married Angela Violante in 1862 (son of the late Bruno and Giuseppa Buetto), a different man, nor the Domenico Sofi of 1872 (Brigante). Not in the family tree. Witnesses at his birth: Don Mariano Randazzo (proprietario) and Giuseppe Pizzarello (ferraro). UPDATE 18 NOVEMBER 2026, HIS DEATH: Scilla Morti 1897 atto 55 (an_ua16601209, image 16, re-zoomed by the session): «SOFI DOMENICO, di anni settanta, pescatore», died at 6.15 in the morning of 16 April 1897 in via Grotte no. 60 (the street of his daughter's household), born at Scilla, son of the late Pasquale, pescatore, and of the late Maria D'Amico, filatrice, and WIDOWER OF ROMANO SANTA; declared by two gravediggers, Filippo Arena and Antonino Amodeo, before the assessore Giovanni D'Amico; the witnesses Antonio Alfonsetti and Annunziato Bova. This closes his line: parents, wife and death in one act, and it puts Santa Romano dead before April 1897. Another Domenico Sofi, son of the late Bruno, died in October 1897 (act 192): a different man. UPDATE 18 NOVEMBER 2026: the date of his wife's death is now found: Santa Romano died on 15 April 1869 (Morti 1869 atto 47), so he was a widower for 28 years.

name: Vittoria Sofi
bornNote: Born at 4 a.m. on 21 December 1822, declared that evening (Scilla, Nati 1822, atto 211, read at the image); father Pasquale Sofi, marinaro, and Maria d'Amico, 'moglie legittima'.
source: Scilla, Nati 1822, atto 211 (an_ua2002816, image 109)
note: Sister of Nunziata Sofi and Domenico Sofi. Witnesses: Pietro Romano (marinaro, 29) and Mariano Arlotta (marinaro, 22); nothing shows Pietro Romano is kin of Santa Romano. Not in the family tree.

name: Teresa Sofi
bornNote: Born at 6 a.m. on 6 May 1831, declared that afternoon (Scilla, Nati 1831, atto 86, read at the image); father Pasquale Sofi, 44, and Maria d'Amico, 40.
source: Scilla, Nati 1831, atto 86 (an_ua2002841, image 53)
note: Sister of Nunziata Sofi and Domenico Sofi. Witnesses: Rocco Floccari (macellaro) and Don Rocco Idà (proprietario). Not in the family tree.

name: Rachele Sofi
bornNote: Born on the evening of 28 February 1834, declared the same day (Scilla, Nati 1834, atto 39, read at the image, parish margin agreeing); the Tavola line reads 27 Febbraio, which the act corrects; father Pasquale Sofi, 43, and Maria d'Amico, 42.
died: 25 November 1834 (at 8 in the evening, aged nine months; Scilla Morti 1834 atto 169, an_ua2002707 image 92, read at the image)
source: Scilla, Nati 1834, atto 39 (an_ua2002850, image 22); Scilla, Morti 1834, atto 169 (an_ua2002707, image 92)
note: Sister of Nunziata Sofi and Domenico Sofi. Witnesses: D. Rocco Federici and D. Rocco Idà (proprietari). Not in the family tree. DIED AT NINE MONTHS, found 22 Nov 2026 by a reader and read at the image by the session: «Rachele Sofi, nata in questo Comune, di mesi nove, figlia di Pasquale Sofi, marinaro, e di Maria de Amico», died in her own house at 20 hours on 25 November 1834; the declarants were Rocco Sofi (38, marinaro) and Domenico Zerina (57, marinaro). The Tavola's order number is not the act number.

name: Santa Romano
bornNote: Born at 9 p.m. on 13 October 1831 at her parents' house in Scilla, declared on 14 October (Nati 1831, atto 173); baptised Santa Romano on the 14th. She is the only Romano girl named Santa in 1829-1834 and the only child of a Concetta Pontillo in those six years.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1855, atto 29 (an_ua2002628, image 34, read in the original); Scilla, Nati 1831, atto 173 (an_ua2002841, image 99, read at the image); Scilla, Morti 1869 atto 47 (an_ua16601181, image 10, read at the image)
note: MARIA SOFI'S MOTHER. Married Domenico Sofi, son of Pasquale Sofi and Maria D'Amico, on 10 September 1855 at Scilla; her father Domenico Romano was dead by July 1855 and her mother Concetta Pontello (the surname read Pontello, which may be the family this archive writes Pontillo) was alive and present at the promise. She and her mother could not write, as the act says of the parents. Not in the family tree. A different Santa Romano married Rocco Scarfone in February 1852 (a daughter of Rocco and Natalina), and a Santa Romano married a Domenico whose surname is unreadable in 1850 (daughter of the late Cosimo): neither is she. HER BIRTH ACT NAMES THE SAME PARENTS AS THE 1855 MARRIAGE: Domenico Romano, 43, marinaro, alive in 1831 and able to sign, and Concetta Pontillo (written Pontilo), 47, his lawful wife; witnesses Domenico Cacciola (fornaio) and Francesco Principato (tessitore). The 1831 Tavola line reads 'Romano Santa, Dom.co e Pontillo Concetta, 13 Ottobre'. Her mother's surname is therefore written Pontillo in the register of her birth and Pontello in her marriage promise. UPDATE 18 NOVEMBER 2026, HER DEATH: Scilla Morti 1869 atto 47 (re-read by the session at the image): «SANTA ROMANO, del fu Domenico e della vivente Concessa Pontillo, moglie di Sofi Domenico», aged forty (the clerk's round figure: the 1831 birth act gives 37), a filatrice, died at 3 p.m. on 15 April 1869 in her own house in the rione Acquagrande; the declarants were two bidelli and could not write. The parents are exactly the pair of her birth act, so she is the same woman, and it puts her death 28 years before her husband's (1897 act: he was her widower). It also means the 1887 marriage act of her daughter Maria (atto 56) writes «Santa Romano» as a parent without «fu» and with a residence at Scilla: that wording cannot mean she was alive, and is recorded as the clerk's formula, not a fact.

name: Annunziato Romano (b. c. 1816, of Domenico Romano and Concetta Pontello)
bornNote: Eighty-six at his death on 24 May 1902 (the age is the act's and not relied on).
source: Scilla, Morti 1902 atto 63 (an_ua16601214, image 34)
note: A PROBABLE BROTHER OF SANTA ROMANO, from the death act alone: ROMANO ANNUNZIATO, a pescatore born at Scilla, died at 8 in the morning of 24 May 1902 in via Acquagrande, son of the late DOMENICO (pescatore) and of the late PONTILLE CONCETTA (filatrice) and husband of Angela Zirilli? (the surname doubtful). The parents' names match the pair in Santa Romano's birth act of 1831 and the surname the act writes, Pontille, is a third spelling of the Pontello and Pontillo family; but the names are common at Scilla and the act does not say he is Santa's brother, so he is carried as a probable one. Declared by Orazio Fontana (56) and Domenico Tescoriere?, the witnesses Pasquale Defrancesco (49) and Filippo Arena (41), before the assessore Gaetano D'Amico. Read by a delegated reader, not re-zoomed by the session.

name: Cosma Romano
bornNote: About forty-nine at her death on 1 March 1872 (the act's age is not relied on).
source: Scilla, Morti 1872 atto 53 (an_ua16601184, image 11, read by a delegated reader and checked in the report)
note: A SISTER OF SANTA ROMANO, from the death act alone: «COSMA ROMANO, dei furono Domenico e Concessa Pontillo, moglie di Santafemia Giovanni», about forty-nine, a filatrice, died at 9 a.m. on 1 March 1872 in her own house in the rione Acquagrande. Her parents are the pair named in Santa's birth act and death act; the act does not name Santa, and the Domenico and Concessa are common names at Scilla, so she is recorded as probable. Her birth year c. 1823 is only the act's age; her birth act has not been looked for. Not in the family tree.

name: Antonino Anile (m. 1836)
bornNote: Twenty-four at his marriage on 8 June 1836; born and living at Mandaradoni, a massaro (farmer). The act was drawn up by the sindaco Pasquale Massara; the church celebration followed on 14 June 1836.
source: Zambrone, Matrimoni 1836, atto 2 (an_ua37928578, image 99, read in the original); FamilySearch, Italy, Catanzaro Civil Registration (State Archive) 1809-1865, name index entry for the 1836 Zambrone marriage (the images of the film are restricted to a FamilySearch Center)
note: A CANDIDATE FOR THE TREE'S ANTONIO ANILE (Briatico), and NOT YET JOINED TO HIM. Antonio Anile and CARMELA COLLIA are the parents the family tree gives Francesco Anile (b. about 1843 at Potenzoni, Briatico), and this act marries an ANTONINO ANILE to a CARMELA COLLIA seven years earlier, at Zambrone, with the first-born Fortunato b. 1838 in the tree fitting the date. Collia is a rare name, so the match is strong. BUT THE PARENTS DISAGREE: the act names the groom's parents as GAETANO (a massaro) and ANNA «di Gaetano» (the surname after the name is read doubtfully), where the tree gives Antonio's parents as Fortunato Anile and Antonia Grasso. Either the tree has the wrong parents or there were two couples. A birth act of one of their children (Briatico Nati or Zambrone Nati, 1837-50) naming BOTH parents would join them or part them; until then they are two entries. Witnesses of the promise: Giuseppe Morello, Francesco Collia, Domenico Pulicari and Gioacchino Trasopoli; the church certificate is witnessed by an Andrea Sambiasi and a Gaetano (surname unread). UPDATE 18 NOVEMBER 2026: the FamilySearch name index of the same act reads the groom as Antonino Anile, born 1812 at MANDARADONI, son of GAETANO ANILE and ANNA DI GAETANO, so the parents' names agree with the session's reading and the question of the tree's Fortunato as his father is unchanged. In that index Mandaradoni never appears as the place where an event was registered (52 entries name it, all as a birthplace or residence in the marriage and death entries of Zambrone, Motta Filocastro, Limbadi and others): it has no register of its own in the collection.

name: Gaetano Anile
bornNote: Named only as the groom's father in the 1836 act: a massaro, living at Mandaradoni.
source: Zambrone, Matrimoni 1836, atto 2 (an_ua37928578, image 99, read in the original)
note: Father of Antonino Anile (m. 1836), living at Mandaradoni in June 1836. Not in the family tree, which gives the tree's Antonio Anile a father called Fortunato; see the note on Antonino Anile.

name: Anna di Gaetano
bornNote: Named only as the groom's mother in the 1836 act, living at Mandaradoni.
source: Zambrone, Matrimoni 1836, atto 2 (an_ua37928578, image 99, read in the original)
note: Mother of Antonino Anile (m. 1836). The act writes «Anna di Gaetano»; whether the second word is her surname or a repeated patronymic is not settled at the image.

name: Carmela Collia (m. 1836)
bornNote: Eighteen at her marriage on 8 June 1836; born and living at Zambrone.
source: Zambrone, Matrimoni 1836, atto 2 (an_ua37928578, image 99, read in the original); FamilySearch, Italy, Catanzaro Civil Registration (State Archive) 1809-1865, name index entry for the 1836 Zambrone marriage (the images of the film are restricted to a FamilySearch Center)
note: A CANDIDATE FOR THE TREE'S CARMELA COLLIA, Antonio Anile's wife (see Antonino Anile, m. 1836, for the whole argument and why they are not yet joined). Her father Francesco was dead in June 1836. The tree has her born at Briatico; this act has her born at Zambrone. Her mother's surname is read «Capucetti» with doubt. UPDATE 18 NOVEMBER 2026, A SECOND READING OF THE SAME ACT: FamilySearch's name index of the Catanzaro State Archive registers carries this marriage (14 June 1836, Zambrone) and reads the bride as CARMELA COLLIA, born 1818 at Zambrone, daughter of FRANCESCO COLLIA and CATARINA CASUSCELLI, with spouse ANTONINO ANILE. The session re-read the act's mother's surname at the image: it reads like Capuscelli, with the second letter group doubtful, and not Capucetti; Casuscelli is a large family of the Vibo Valentia comuni (the same index holds several hundred entries, at Zambrone, Potenzoni, San Costantino and Filogaso), so the indexer's reading is the likelier. HER BIRTH ACT IS NOT AVAILABLE: the Zambrone births of 1813 to 1821 are missing from the Catanzaro copy, and the FamilySearch film's images are restricted to a FamilySearch Center or affiliate library. 24 NOV 2026, THE ZAMBRONE BIRTH VOLUME: her birth (about 1818) is NOT in the volume, which has no 1813-1821 (see the volume's year map in the Zambrone ark list). A girl named Carmela Collia born 29 July 1812 (Zambrone Nati 1812 atto 17) is a different child: her father Domenico Collia was dead and her mother is Marianna Muggere, and at 18 in June 1836 the bride was born about 1818, not 1812.

name: Francesco Collia
bornNote: Named only as the bride's father in the 1836 act, who was dead by June 1836 (a Francesco Collia, no relation stated, is one of the witnesses of the promise).
source: Zambrone, Matrimoni 1836, atto 2 (an_ua37928578, image 99, read in the original)
note: Father of Carmela Collia (m. 1836), dead by 8 June 1836. The act does not say he is the same man as the witness Francesco Collia, who is more likely a namesake relative. 24 NOV 2026: a Francesco Collia, agricoltore aged thirty-four, declared a son born 21 March 1811 to Catarina Casuscelli, his legitimate wife (Zambrone Nati 1811 atto 6, image 6, read at the image); the act does not name the child. Another Francesco Collia is recorded with a Rosa Casuscelli in act 2 of 12 February 1811, twins in 1812 and a child in 1823, so there were two namesake households or one clerk's confusion of the wife's name; which is the bride's father is not decided.

name: Teresa Collia (b. c. 1821, of Francesco Collia and Catarina Casuscelli)
bornNote: Born about 1821 at Zambrone, from her death entry alone.
source: FamilySearch, Italy, Catanzaro Civil Registration (State Archive) 1809-1865, name index entry for her death in 1825 (the images of the film are restricted to a FamilySearch Center)
note: A PROBABLE SISTER OF CARMELA COLLIA, from the name index alone and not from the act: the FamilySearch index of the Catanzaro State Archive registers lists a TERESA COLLIA, dead at Zambrone on 7 April 1825, born about 1821 at Zambrone, daughter of Francesco Collia and Catarina Casuscelli, the parents it also gives Carmela Collia in 1836. Francesco Collia is a common name at Zambrone, so this is a probable tie, not a proved one; the act itself has not been read and its images are restricted. Not in the family tree.

name: Catarina Capucetti
bornNote: Named only as the bride's mother in the 1836 act, living at Zambrone.
source: Zambrone, Matrimoni 1836, atto 2 (an_ua37928578, image 99, read in the original); FamilySearch, Italy, Catanzaro Civil Registration (State Archive) 1809-1865, name index entry for the 1836 Zambrone marriage (the images of the film are restricted to a FamilySearch Center)
note: Mother of Carmela Collia (m. 1836). The surname is read Capucetti with doubt (it may be Capuccetti or Capocetti). UPDATE 18 NOVEMBER 2026: FamilySearch's name index of this marriage reads her surname CASUSCELLI (Catarina Casuscelli), and the index holds a Francesco Collia and Catarina Casuscelli as parents of a Teresa Collia born about 1821 at Zambrone, who died there on 7 April 1825 (see Teresa Collia, b. c. 1821). The session's own re-read at the image gives Capuscelli with the second letter group doubtful: the name is the Casuscelli family, probably, and the row keeps the name the act's clerk wrote until a better reading settles it.

name: Domenico Romano
bornNote: FORTY-THREE when he declared his daughter Santa's birth in October 1831 (Scilla, Nati 1831, atto 173); a marinaro of Scilla.
died: before 6 July 1855 (the promise of his daughter Santa's marriage calls him fu; his widow's death act of 1870 calls her vedova di Romano Domenico)
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1855, atto 29 (an_ua2002628, image 34, read in the original); Scilla, Nati 1831, atto 173 (an_ua2002841, image 99, read at the image)

Alive in 1831 and signed his own name on the act; dead by July 1855. UPDATE 18 NOVEMBER 2026: not found in the Scilla death registers 1866-87 or 1894 (index read in full each year but 1871 and 1884, which have no index), so he very probably died before civil registration began in 1866 or before 1855. His widow Concetta Pontillo's death act of 1870 names him.

name: Concetta Pontello
bornNote: FORTY-SEVEN at her daughter Santa's birth in October 1831 (Scilla, Nati 1831, atto 173).
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1855, atto 29 (an_ua2002628, image 34, read in the original); Scilla, Nati 1831, atto 173 (an_ua2002841, image 99, read at the image); Scilla, Morti 1870 atto 152 (an_ua16601182, image 28, read at the image)
note: Mother of Santa Romano, who married Domenico Sofi in 1855; the surname is read Pontello at the image (the Pontillo of this archive's other pages is a candidate for the same family, not asserted). Not in the family tree. The 1831 birth act and Tavola write the surname PONTILLO (Pontilo); the 1855 promise reads Pontello. The Atlas catalogue holds Pontillo as a lead and Pontello as attested, and the register of 1831 now supports Pontillo as the same family's own spelling. UPDATE 18 NOVEMBER 2026, HER DEATH: Scilla Morti 1870 atto 152 (read at the image): «CONCESSA PONTILLO, dei furono Domenico e Nicolina Costa, vedova di Romano Domenico», about eighty-eight, poor, died at 8 p.m. on 24 December 1870 in her own house in the rione Acquagrande. Her age agrees with the c. 1784 birth year (47 in 1831). Her parents are the late Domenico Pontillo and Nicolina Costa. She was alive on 15 April 1869 (her daughter Santa's death act calls her vivente). The Annunziato Romano of 1902 calls her fu Pontille Concetta: consistent.

name: Mariano Mazza (b. 1866, of Salvatore and Leonarda Patane)
bornNote: Nati 1866 atto 145 (an_ua83479, image 45; margin and body both write MARRA, 'Marra Mariano'): born 5 September at 9 in the evening, declared 9 September 1866 (Ignazio Fragala, assessore), contrada Terremorte; father Salvatore Marra di Mariano, 25, bracciale; mother Leonarda Patane di Alfio. father: Salvatore Mazza (b. 1841, of Mariano and Maria Catalano)

His death has not been sought.

name: Francesca Mazza (b. 1866, of Pasquale and Concetta Greco)
bornNote: Nati 1866 atto 169, supplement (an_ua83479, image 54; margin 'Marra Francesca'): born 15 October, declared 16 October 1866, Via Borgo; father Pasquale Marra di Senzio, 34, bracciale; mother Concetta Greco di Domenico; witnesses Salvatore Dibella fu Giuseppe, 36, and Leonardo Amante fu Ignazio. father: Pasquale Mazza (b. c. 1829, husband of Concetta Greco)
source: Piedimonte Etneo, Nati 1866 atto 169 (an_ua83479, image 54)

name: Salvatore Mazza (b. 1891, of Domenico and Maria Russo)
bornNote: Nati 1891 atto 110 (an_ua83505, image 63; the index writes Marza Salvatore di Domenico): born 26 June at 5.30 in the morning, declared 28 June 1891 before the assessore supplente Vincenzo Coglitore; father Domenico Mazza, 31, bracciante; mother Maria Russo, industriosa; Via S. Basilio n. 50. Read at the image by the session, which could not see the witnesses (second page masked); the delegated reader gives them as Zappala Emidio, 68, and Stiro Alfio, 42. A later stamped annotation records his marriage to Angela Sorbello on 20 May 1920, registered no. 83, Catania 16 June 1925.

name: Alfonso Prostamo (b. 20 July 1855, of Domenico Prostamo and Giovanna Ventrice)
bornNote: BORN AT BRIATICO at four in the afternoon of 20 July 1855 (Briatico Nati 1855 atto 21, an_ua87756, image 22, right page, read at the image): declared the same day by his father Domenico Prostamo («di anni quaranta», marinaro, domiciled at Briatico), who says the child is born of Giovanna Ventrice (her age written, not settled here) and of himself, in their own house, «in costanza di legittimo matrimonio»; named Alfonso Prostamo; the two witnesses, on the left page of the next opening (image 23), are Gaetano Callipo? (falegname, aged about forty) and Paolo Francica? (muratore), both domiciled at Briatico, the surnames not settled; the declarant's closing line says he could not write.
source: Briatico, Nati 1855, atto 21 (an_ua87756, image 22; Tavola entry 21 on image 47)
note: A SECOND ALFONSO, OR THE FIRST ONE WITH A WRONG DATE: NOT DECIDED. The tree's Alfonso Prostamo (the one who married Caterina Melluso on 21 May 1887) is entered as born 1858, and the ages recorded for him, 24 in January 1886 and 25 in May 1887, point to about 1862. This act gives a child of the SAME PARENTS named Alfonso on 20 July 1855, which would make that man thirty-one and thirty-two in 1886-87. Either the 1855 child died young and a later son (about 1861-62) took the name, as families did, or he is the same man and both ages are wrong by six or seven years. No death of a Prostamo child is in the Briatico Tavole of 1855-58 (the 1855, 1857 and 1858 death volumes are partial) and the registers for 1859-1862 are not on Antenati, so the choice needs the 1887 marriage act itself (it names his parents and his age) or the Briatico Nati and Morti of 1859-1862 on FamilySearch. Kept apart from the tree's Alfonso until then; nothing merged. Read 24 Nov 2026.
